summary: PTC Therapeutics filed an 8-K announcing completion of its previously disclosed acquisition of ST-920, a BLA-stage, one-time AAV gene therapy for Fabry disease, from Sangamo Therapeutics. No financial terms, price per share, or premium were disclosed in the excerpt. PTC expects to complete a rolling BLA submission to the FDA for accelerated approval in Q4 2026, based on 52-week Phase 1/2 STAAR data showing favorable renal function and tolerability, and will pursue ex-U.S. approvals. The filing is largely a closing confirmation under Items 7.01/8.01; watch for milestone payments, Sangamo's cash runway, and BLA timing risk.
